source: 上外版选择性必修第一册 Unit 2 词表(p74-76 真词);跳过 △ 超纲词与专有名词;IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、志愿服务/公益主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: She decided to volunteer at the local animal shelter.
words.example_cn: 她决定去当地的动物收容所做志愿者。

words.example_en: Many people donate food and clothes to the homeless shelter.
words.example_cn: 许多人向无家可归者收容所捐赠食物和衣物。

words.example_en: He works for a wildlife conservation organisation.
words.example_cn: 他在一家野生动物保护组织工作。

words.meaning_cn: 收容所;庇护所;遮蔽;保护
words.example_en: Volunteers feed the dogs at the animal shelter every weekend.
words.example_cn: 志愿者每个周末都到动物收容所给狗喂食。

words.meaning_cn: 运动;活动;参加(或发起)运动
words.example_en: Jackson led a campaign to reduce plastic pollution in his town.
words.example_cn: 杰克逊在他的镇上发起了一场减少塑料污染的运动。

words.example_en: The club aims to promote the use of reusable water bottles.
words.example_cn: 这个俱乐部旨在推广可重复使用水瓶的使用。

words.example_en: Volunteers urged local restaurants to stop using plastic straws.
words.example_cn: 志愿者力劝当地餐馆停止使用塑料吸管。

words.example_en: Thousands of young people have joined the green movement.
words.example_cn: 成千上万的年轻人加入了环保运动。

words.example_en: The students organised a march to raise awareness of water rights.
words.example_cn: 学生们组织了一场游行来提高人们对水权的认识。

words.example_en: The two boys launched a website to connect children with volunteer work.
words.example_cn: 这两个男孩创建了一个网站,把孩子们和志愿工作联系起来。

words.example_en: They built a database of local volunteer opportunities.
words.example_cn: 他们建立了一个当地志愿机会的数据库。

words.example_en: She volunteers with an urban farming group in the city.
words.example_cn: 她在城里的一个城市农业团体做志愿者。

words.example_en: Many organisations request to be listed on the volunteer website.
words.example_cn: 许多组织请求被列入这个志愿者网站。

words.example_en: The children earned money for charity by selling lemonade.
words.example_cn: 孩子们靠卖柠檬水为慈善事业筹钱。

words.example_en: He raised money to purchase GPS collars for the animals.
words.example_cn: 他筹款为这些动物购买GPS颈圈。

words.example_en: Xiao Meng works as a guide in the clock gallery of the museum.
words.example_cn: 小萌在博物馆的钟表陈列室当导览员。

words.example_en: Twenty-five emperors once lived in this ancient palace.
words.example_cn: 曾有二十五位皇帝住在这座古老的宫殿里。

words.example_en: As the guide says, every brick of the palace has a story to tell.
words.example_cn: 正如导览员所说,宫殿的每一块砖都有故事可讲。

words.example_en: The twin brothers started the website together when they were fourteen.
words.example_cn: 这对双胞胎兄弟十四岁时一起创办了这个网站。

words.example_en: Their mission at the orphanage was to build a library.
words.example_cn: 他们在孤儿院的任务是建一座图书馆。

words.meaning_cn: 履行(诺言);兑现;递送;发表
words.example_en: The students found that they could not deliver on this mission.
words.example_cn: 学生们发现他们无法完成这项任务。

words.example_en: They were very bad at the most basic construction work.
words.example_cn: 他们连最基本的建筑活儿都干得很糟。

words.example_en: Local men came back at night to rebuild the structure.
words.example_cn: 当地人晚上回来重建那座建筑。

words.example_en: It would have been better to hire local workers to do the job.
words.example_cn: 雇当地工人来做这活儿本会更好。

words.example_en: Her failure at the simple act of gift giving taught her a lesson.
words.example_cn: 她在送礼这件简单事上的失败给她上了一课。

words.meaning_cn: 令人尴尬的;难堪的;笨拙的
words.example_en: The most awkward part was her mistake over the gifts.
words.example_cn: 最尴尬的部分是她在礼物上犯的错误。

words.meaning_cn: 合乎情理的;合逻辑的;必然的
words.example_en: Collecting hair bands for the girls seemed logical to her at first.
words.example_cn: 起初为那些女孩收集发带在她看来合情合理。

words.example_en: She thought the gifts were cute and fashionable.
words.example_cn: 她觉得这些礼物既可爱又时髦。

words.example_en: The girls were wearing their crisp school uniforms.
words.example_cn: 女孩们穿着干净挺括的校服。

words.meaning_cn: 通常的;平常的;有规律的;经常的
words.example_en: A short haircut is a regular part of the schoolgirl uniform there.
words.example_cn: 短发是那里女生校服的一个常规部分。

words.meaning_cn: 官员;要员;公务的;官方的
words.example_en: The girls' hair is highly regulated by school officials.
words.example_cn: 女孩们的头发受到学校官员的严格管理。

words.example_en: With all my resources, I should have done more research first.
words.example_cn: 拥有这么多资源,我本应先做更多调查。

words.example_en: This kind of volunteering trip has been criticized recently.
words.example_cn: 这类志愿旅行最近受到了不少批评。

words.example_en: If you travel with the intention of helping, do your research first.
words.example_cn: 如果你带着帮助他人的意图去旅行,先做好调查。

words.example_en: Don't assume that others value the same things you do.
words.example_cn: 别想当然地以为别人看重的东西和你一样。

words.example_en: Even highly educated students may fail at simple practical tasks.
words.example_cn: 即使是受过良好教育的学生也可能在简单的实际任务上失败。

words.example_en: The advertisement offered only a small wage for hard work.
words.example_cn: 这则广告对辛苦的工作只给很少的工资。

words.example_en: They designed an advertisement to find volunteers for the project.
words.example_cn: 他们设计了一则广告来为项目招募志愿者。

words.example_en: She had worn a hair band on her wrist for years.
words.example_cn: 她手腕上戴发带已经很多年了。

words.example_en: The money was used to buy GPS collars to protect the cheetahs.
words.example_cn: 这笔钱被用来购买GPS颈圈以保护猎豹。

words.example_en: The volunteers also played a few soccer games with the children.
words.example_cn: 志愿者还和孩子们踢了几场足球。

words.example_en: He organised a march in his county to protect water rights.
words.example_cn: 他在自己所在的县组织了一场保护水权的游行。

words.example_en: He is determined to fight plastic pollution in his town.
words.example_cn: 他决心在自己的镇上对抗塑料污染。

words.example_en: The schoolgirls all had closely cropped hair.
words.example_cn: 女生们的头发都剪得很短。
